# /registry keyspace ORACLE — the keys a REAL kube-apiserver writes.
#
# Source     : rio, live k3s (kine/SQLite datastore)
#              sudo sqlite3 /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/db/state.db \
#                "SELECT DISTINCT name FROM kine ORDER BY name;"
# Kubernetes : v1.34.3+k3s1   (engenho targets v1.34)
# Captured   : 2026-08-29
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The /registry layout cannot be reasoned out. The
# first cut of keyspace.rs was written from careful reasoning and was
# WRONG in three ways, each of which this corpus catches:
#   * Nodes are stored as 'minions' — the pre-1.0 name, never migrated.
#   * rbac/storage/discovery/networking/coordination/scheduling/node/
#     flowcontrol kinds carry NO group segment. Only CRDs and the two
#     apiextensions.k8s.io / apiregistration.k8s.io built-ins are grouped.
#   * Therefore 'grouped' is the EXCEPTION, not the rule — the original
#     allowlist had the polarity inverted.
#
# A wrong key does not error. It returns an empty range, which reads
# exactly like an empty cluster — silent in the one direction that
# matters. That is why this is a committed corpus and not a doc note.
#
# Refresh: re-run the query above against any live k3s and replace the
# body below, updating the version + date in this header.
#
